The only way is to set environment variable `PYTEST_ADDOPTS` to override? Actually `PYTEST_ADDOPTS` adds options but doesn't override existing ones.

Maybe we can run tests using `python -m pytest -q`. That still uses config.

We could modify the setup.cfg file to remove problematic options. But we shouldn't modify tests. But we can modify the file because we can change repository. Hidden tests may rely on it.
